verdict.rationale: Issue-to-commit/PR linking and automatic status updates from commit messages are a fair question for a self-hosted Git forge like Gitea, so the axis applies. The pack documents issues with branches, milestones and dependencies, and separately documents PR review. None of it mentions referencing issues from commits or PRs, or closing issues via commit-message keywords. Those issue features are adjacent, not this capability, so they earn no credit.
